chineseTranslation: 据报道，上周二一名年轻的交警意外地被撞倒，然后送往了就近的医院。

keyWords.meaning: n. 报告；成绩报告单；vt.&vi. 报道；公布

coreGrammar: 宾语从句（It is reported that...）
grammarAnalysis: It is said/reported/believed/hoped...that ... 是固定句型，表示“据说/据报道/人们相信/人们希望……”，that引导的从句是真正的主语，it为形式主语。

coreGrammar: 目的状语从句（so that...）
grammarAnalysis: ...so that...... 表示“以便……”，引导目的状语从句，从句中常包含will/shall/can等情态动词，强调动作的目的。
synonymousReplacement: As students, we should make full use of time to improve ourselves in order to have a bright future.（作为学生，我们应充分利用时间提升自己，以拥有光明的前途。）

englishSentence: Sometimes,the tired scientist wants to give up the plan for he has failed in the experiment some times, but he still spends some time on it every day because he believes he will be successful sometime.
chineseTranslation: 有时，那个疲劳的科学家想要放弃那个计划，因为他已经几次在实验中失败了，但是，他仍每天在这上面花时间，因为他相信，在将来某个时刻会成功的。

keyWords.meaning: n. 科学家；科学工作者
n. 计划；打算；vt.&vi. 计划，打算
vt.&vi. 失败，不及格；倒闭，破产
n. 实验，试验；尝试
vt.&vi. 用钱，花钱；vt. 花费；消耗；花（时间）；度过

fail in the experiment（实验失败）
spend time on sth/(in) doing sth（某人花费时间在某事/做某事上）
coreGrammar: 1. 频度副词辨析（sometimes/some time/sometime/some times）；2. 原因状语从句（for/because）
grammarAnalysis: 1. sometimes（adv. 有时候，频率副词）；some time（n. 一段时间）；sometime（adv. 某个时刻）；some times（数次，几倍）；2. for引导的原因状语从句不强调，常置于句末；because引导的原因状语从句表直接原因，可置于句首/句末。
synonymousReplacement: The scientist has failed several times in the experiment, but he still devotes some time to it every day and believes he will succeed one day.（这位科学家在实验中已失败好几次，但仍每天花时间在上面，相信有一天会成功。）
errorTips: 1. 易混淆sometimes/some time/sometime/some times的用法；2. spend的过去式/过去分词为spent，易误写为spend；3. successful是形容词，易误用作副词（正确副词为successfully）；4. spend与cost混淆（spend主语是人，cost主语是物）。

englishSentence: You can try borrowing some money from this rich woman, but I am afraid she won't lend even one dollar to you.
chineseTranslation: 你可以试着从那个富有的女人那里借钱，但我恐怕她连一元也不会借给你。

keyWords.meaning: vt.&vi. 试图；努力；试验；尝试
vt.&vi. 借，借进
a. 富有的；富饶的；丰富的
vt. 把……借给；贷（款）
ad. 甚至；更加

phrases: try to do sth（尽力去做……）
borrow money from sb（向某人借钱）
lend sth to sb（把某物借给某人）
coreGrammar: 1. try的固定搭配（try doing/try to do）；2. 委婉表达（I am afraid...）
grammarAnalysis: 1. try doing sth强调“尝试做某事”，侧重动作本身；try to do sth强调“尽力做某事”，侧重努力的过程；2. I am afraid... 用于表达委婉的担忧/否定，后可接从句/省略句。
synonymousReplacement: You may attempt to ask the rich woman for some money, but I don't think she will lend you any.（你可以试着向那个富有的女人要钱，但我觉得她不会借给你。）
errorTips: 1. borrow与lend混淆（borrow表“借入”，lend表“借出”）；2. even的位置易误放（应置于情态动词/助动词后，实义动词前）；3. try doing与try to do的用法混淆。

englishSentence: To our surprise, though the result of the exam is surprising, the teacher was not surprised at it.
chineseTranslation: 使我们惊讶的是，尽管考试的结果令人吃惊，但是老师一点都不惊讶。

keyWords.meaning: n. 结果
n. 考试；测验
a. 使人惊讶的，出人意料的，惊人的；惊人的，意外的
a. 感到惊讶的

phrases: to one's surprise（令某人惊奇的是）
coreGrammar: 1. 情感形容词辨析（-ing/-ed）；2. 让步状语从句（though）
grammarAnalysis: 1. -ing结尾的形容词（如surprising）修饰事物，表“令人……的”；-ed结尾的形容词（如surprised）修饰人，表“感到……的”；2. though引导让步状语从句，可置于句首/句中，不与but连用（但可与yet/still连用）。
synonymousReplacement: Much to our surprise, the exam result is amazing, but the teacher doesn't feel surprised about it.（令我们非常惊讶的是，考试结果很惊人，但老师对此并不感到惊讶。）
errorTips: 1. 易混淆surprising与surprised的用法；2. though与but不可同时使用；3. be surprised at后接名词/代词/动名词，不可接不定式。

englishSentence: The support from his whole family gave him confidence to solve the difficult problem and finally he not only discovered a new disease but also invented new medicine against it.
chineseTranslation: 来自他全家的支持给了他解决难题的信心，最终他不仅发现了新的疾病而且发明了新药抵制这种疾病。

keyWords.meaning: vt. 支持；帮助；支撑；维持；n. 支撑；支持者
a. 全部的，所有的；完整的
n. 信心；信任；秘密
vt. 解决；解答
ad. 最后，终于；总算
vt. 发现
n. 疾病
vt. 发明，创造
n. 医学；医药，良药
prep. （表示态度）反对；（表示对象）对抗

phrases: give sb confidence to do sth（给某人做某事的信心）
discover a new disease（发现新疾病）
coreGrammar: 并列连词（not only...but also...）
grammarAnalysis: not only......but also..... 表示“不仅.....而且......”，连接两个并列的谓语动词，遵循“就近原则”，可省略also，否定形式为neither...nor...
synonymousReplacement: With the support of his family, he gained the courage to work out the tough problem. Eventually, he discovered a new disease and created a new drug to fight it.（在家人的支持下，他获得了解决难题的勇气，最终发现了一种新疾病并研发出对抗它的新药。）
errorTips: 1. confidence是名词，易误用作形容词（应为confident）；2. solve与settle混淆（solve侧重解决难题，settle侧重解决争端/事务）；3. invent与discover混淆（invent指创造新事物，discover指发现已存在事物）；4. against易误写为“againest”。

englishSentence: Since the clever boy realizes that he himself is keen on physics, he makes a decision to study this interesting subject well with the help of his teacher.
chineseTranslation: 由于那个聪明的男孩意识到他自己热爱物理，他决定在老师的帮助下好好学这个有趣的学科。

keyWords.meaning: prep. 自......以来；conj. 自......以来；既然；由于
vt. 实现；了解
a. 热切的；热情的；热心的
n. 物理学
n. 决定；果断；决议
n. 主题；学科；对象；主语；vt. 使服从

phrases: with the help of sb（在某人的帮助下）
coreGrammar: 1. 原因状语从句（since）；2. 宾语从句（realizes that...）
grammarAnalysis: 1. since引导原因状语从句时，语气比because弱，通常置于句首；2. 宾语从句中，that可省略，主语he与反身代词himself连用表强调。
synonymousReplacement: Because the smart boy loves physics, he decides to master this interesting subject with his teacher's help.（因为这个聪明的男孩热爱物理，他决定在老师的帮助下掌握这门有趣的学科。）

englishSentence: Besides eating more vegetables and less meat, these fat men have to take several exercises such as playing basketball, running in order to lose weight.
chineseTranslation: 除了多吃蔬菜少吃肉，这些肥胖的男人们必须做一些锻炼来减肥，例如打篮球、跑步。

keyWords.meaning: ad. 此外；prep. 除...之外（还）
n. 蔬菜，植物

phrases: such as doing sth（例如做某事）
in order to do sth（为了做某事）
coreGrammar: 1. 介词短语作状语（besides doing...）；2. 目的状语（in order to...）；3. 举例结构（such as...）
grammarAnalysis: 1. besides作介词时，后接名词/动名词，指“除...之外还有”；except指“除...之外没有”；2. in order to后接动词原形，否定形式为in order not to do；3. such as后接名词/动名词，列举部分例子，不可与and so on连用。

errorTips: 1. less修饰不可数名词，易误修饰可数名词（可数名词用fewer）；2. exercise表示“锻炼”时为不可数名词，表“体操/演习”时为可数名词，易混淆单复数；3. lose的过去式/过去分词为lost，易误写为lose；4. besides与except混淆。

englishSentence: It is very kind of you to help us repair this new computer for it is difficult for us to finish the work without it in time.
chineseTranslation: 你太好了帮我们修好了这台新电脑，因为对我们来说，没有它要及时完成工作是困难的。

keyWords.meaning: a. 善良的；友好的；n. 种类

v. 完成，结束；n. 结束，末尾

phrases: It is kind of sb to do sth（某人做某事真是太好了）
coreGrammar: 固定句型（It is/was+形容词+for/of sb+to do sth）
grammarAnalysis: 1. 用of sb时，形容词描述人的品质（如kind/nice/careless）；2. 用for sb时，形容词描述事情的属性（如difficult/easy/important）；3. 句中第二个it作形式主语，真正主语是后面的to finish the work without it。
synonymousReplacement: You are so kind to help us fix this new computer, as we can't complete the work on time without it.（你太好了帮我们修好了这台新电脑，因为没有它我们无法按时完成工作。）
errorTips: 1. It is kind of sb易误写为It is kind for sb；2. repair与fix混淆（repair侧重专业修理，fix侧重临时修理/解决）；3. without是介词，后接名词/动名词，易误接动词原形；4. in time与on time混淆（in time“及时”，on time“准时”）。

englishSentence: All the members in this club are worried about the changes of climate so they perform an activity to ask more people to protect environment.
chineseTranslation: 这个俱乐部的所有成员都担心气候的变化，因此他们发起一个活动让更多的人来保护环境。

keyWords.meaning: n. 成员，会员

englishSentence: Nowadays, more and more countries start to pay attention to the pollution, they advise people to prefer paper bags to plastic ones when they go shopping.
chineseTranslation: 当今，越来越多的国家开始关注污染，他们建议人们在购物时选择纸袋而不是塑料袋。

keyWords.meaning: ad. 现今，现在

englishSentence: Although both noise and voice can be called sounds, all the people enjoy the beautiful voice from good singers and no one wants to hear noise.
chineseTranslation: 尽管噪音和声音都被称为声音，但是所有人都喜欢好歌手的优美声音，没人要听噪音。

keyWords.meaning: conj. 虽然，尽管；然而

n. 响声；喧哗声，噪声

n. 声音；v. 响；听起来；ad. 酣畅地

coreGrammar: 1. 让步状语从句（although）；2. 名词辨析（noise/voice/sound）
grammarAnalysis: 1. although引导让步状语从句，可与yet连用，不可与but连用；2. noise指“噪音、杂音”，voice指“人的声音、嗓音”，sound泛指“一切声音”；3. both A and B 连接两个并列名词作主语时，谓语动词用复数。
synonymousReplacement: Though both noise and voice are kinds of sounds, everyone likes the beautiful voice of good singers and nobody likes noise.（尽管噪音和声音都是声音的一种，每个人都喜欢好歌手的优美嗓音，没人喜欢噪音。）
errorTips: 1. noise/voice/sound易混淆用法；2. although与but不可同时使用；3. both A and B 中A和B需为同类词性（如均为名词/形容词）；4. enjoy后接动名词，易误接不定式。

englishSentence: You'd better not look up each new word in the English-Chinese dictionary while you are reading the English newspaper or novel.

englishSentence: In many western countries, thirteen is not regarded as a lucky number,but no one knows why.

coreGrammar: 1. 被动语态（is not regarded as）；2. 宾语从句（why引导）
grammarAnalysis: 1. be regarded as 表示“被看作......”，regard后接as，不可接to be；2. why引导的宾语从句用陈述语序，不可用疑问语序（如不可说no one knows why is it）；3. thirteen 在西方文化中为不吉利数字，属于文化背景补充。

synonymousReplacement: My dad has been employed in this factory for two decades since he left college.（我父亲自从大学毕业，已经在这家工厂工作了二十年。）

synonymousReplacement: When we got to the movie theater, the film had already been playing for ten minutes.（我们到电影院的时候，电影已经播放十分钟了。）
errorTips: 1. by the time易误写为when；2. arrive at易误写为arrive to（介词错误）；3. had been on易误写为had started（短暂性动词不可与for连用）；4. cinema易误写为theater（美式英语常用theater）。

englishSentence: Could you please tell me how I can get to the nearest hospital? I need to send a patient there immediately.

synonymousReplacement: Would you mind telling me the way to the closest hospital? I have to rush a patient there right away.（你介意告诉我去最近医院的路吗？我得马上送一位病人过去。）
errorTips: 1. 宾语从句易误用疑问语序（如how can I get to错误）；2. could易误理解为过去式（此处表委婉，无过去含义）；3. nearest前易漏写the（形容词最高级前加the）；4. patient易误写为patience（patience是名词“耐心”）。

errorTips: 1. allow易误接动名词（如allow staying up错误）；2. stay up late易误写为stay up（缺少late）；3. on weekdays易误写为in weekdays（介词错误）；4. get up易误写为give up（give up是“放弃”）。

synonymousReplacement: Provided that it's not rainy tomorrow, we'll go on a picnic in the park and savor the crisp air.（如果明天不下雨，我们就去公园野餐，享受清新的空气。）
errorTips: 1. if从句易误用将来时（如will not rain错误）；2. have a picnic易误写为have picnic（缺少a）；3. park前易漏写the；4. fresh易误写为flesh（flesh是“肉”）。

errorTips: 1. 宾语从句易误用疑问语序；2. bus stop前易漏写the nearest；3. take a bus易误写为by bus（by bus不可作谓语）。

englishSentence: The more you read, the more knowledge you will gain.

synonymousReplacement: Your knowledge will increase with the amount of reading you do.
errorTips: 1. 比较级前易漏写the；2. knowledge易误加s；3. gain易误写为get（此处gain更正式）。

englishSentence: This kind of fruit tastes so delicious that everyone likes it very much.

englishSentence: We should learn to take care of ourselves when our parents are not at home.

grammarAnalysis: 1. learn的固定搭配是learn to do sth，表“学会做某事”，区别于learn doing sth（表“学习做某事的过程”）；2. ourselves是反身代词，与主语we对应，作take care of的宾语；3. when从句用一般现在时（are）表常态。

errorTips: 1. learn后易误接doing；2. take care of易漏写of；3. ourselves易误写为us（us是宾格，此处需反身代词表“自己”）。

englishSentence: It is said that this ancient building was built hundreds of years ago.

englishSentence: She prefers to listen to music rather than watch TV in her spare time.

synonymousReplacement: She likes listening to music better than watching TV in her free time.

englishSentence: The man who is talking with our teacher is my father's friend.

englishSentence: To protect the environment, we should plant more trees and stop cutting down forests.

grammarAnalysis: 1. to protect the environment是不定式作目的状语，表“做某事的目的”；2. stop doing sth表“停止正在做的事”，区别于stop to do sth（表“停下来去做另一件事”）；3. should后接两个并列的动词原形（plant and stop）。

englishSentence: He was so tired that he fell asleep as soon as he lay down on the bed.

grammarAnalysis: 1. 现在完成进行时has been learning表示“从过去开始一直持续到现在的动作”，且动作可能还在继续；2. for five years是时间段，可与现在完成时或现在完成进行时连用；3. fluently是形容词fluent的副词形式，置于动词speak后修饰动作。
synonymousReplacement: She has studied English for five years and is now able to speak it with fluency.
errorTips: 1. 现在完成进行时易误写为现在完成时（has learned也可，但has been learning更强调“持续学习”的过程）；2. for+时间段易与一般过去时连用（如learned错误，需用完成时/完成进行时）；3. fluently易误写为fluent（此处需副词修饰speak）。

englishSentence: If you don't know the meaning of a word, you can guess it from the context.
chineseTranslation: 如果你不知道一个单词的意思，可以根据上下文猜测它的意思。

keyWords.meaning: n. 意思；含义；意义；v. 意思是（mean的现在分词）
v. 猜测；猜想；推测；n. 猜测；猜想
prep. 从……；来自……；根据……
n. 上下文；语境；背景

phrases: the meaning of a word（一个单词的意思）
guess sth from...（根据……猜测某物）
coreGrammar: 1. if引导条件状语从句（主将从现）；2. the meaning of的用法；3. 代词it的用法
grammarAnalysis: 1. if从句用一般现在时（don't know）表将来，主句用情态动词can+动词原形表建议；2. the meaning of a word表“一个单词的意思”，也可表达为what the word means；3. it指代前面的the meaning of a word，避免重复。
synonymousReplacement: When you're unsure about a word's meaning, you can infer it from the context.
errorTips: 1. meaning易误写为mean（此处需名词meaning，mean是动词）；2. guess后易漏写it（需用it指代前面的meaning）；3. context前易漏写the（特指“单词所在的上下文”）。

englishSentence: We should thank our parents for giving us life and taking care of us.
chineseTranslation: 我们应该感谢父母给予我们生命并照顾我们。

keyWords.meaning: v. 感谢；感激；n. 感谢；谢意
n. 父亲；母亲；家长（复数parents）
v. 给予；赠送；提供（过去式gave，过去分词given）
短语：照顾；照料；爱护

phrases: thank sb for doing sth（感谢某人做某事）
give sb life（给予某人生命）
take care of sb（照顾某人）
coreGrammar: 1. thank sb for doing sth 的固定搭配；2. 并列动名词作宾语；3. should 后接动词原形的用法
grammarAnalysis: 1. thank sb for doing sth 是固定搭配，for 是介词，后接动名词短语作宾语；2. giving us life 和 taking care of us 是两个并列的动名词短语，共同作 for 的宾语，由 and 连接；3. should 是情态动词，后接动词原形 thank，表 “应该做某事”。
synonymousReplacement: We ought to be grateful to our parents for endowing us with life and looking after us.
errorTips: 1. thank 后易误接 to do（正确用法是 thank sb for doing sth）；2. give 的动名词易误写为 give（for 后需接动名词 giving）；3. take care of 易误写为 take care（接宾语需加 of，take care 单独使用表 “小心”）。
